policy: Official government, intergovernmental and statutory-regulator sources only. Inclusion is evidence of the stated scope, not an exhaustive current inventory for a jurisdiction.

sources.title: CICIC directory coverage
sources.scope: Defines coverage and cautions that current regulatory changes may not yet appear.

sources.title: CICIC advanced occupation search
sources.scope: Official directory search; raw 135-result regulated snapshot is saved separately.

sources.title: Foreign credential recognition
sources.scope: Credential recognition and licensing depend on the occupation and place of work.

sources.title: Qualifications recognition: regulatory bodies
sources.scope: Current government regulator list; regulator membership does not by itself establish compulsory practice licensing for every related job.

sources.title: Regulated professions in scope of review
sources.scope: Published October 2024. Historical government occupation inventory; requires current regulator checks before classification.

sources.title: Professional regulatory authorities
sources.scope: Regulatory authority directory, grouped by sector.

sources.title: Career occupations and other regulators
sources.scope: Includes provincial and federal regulators; distinguishes additional organizations that are not regulatory bodies. Thirteen regulator rows saved.

sources.title: Regulated occupations
sources.scope: Regulated-profession list and nine compulsory trades. Official indexed page used when direct retrieval returned HTTP 403.

sources.title: Certified occupations
sources.scope: Fifty occupation/regulator rows from official indexed content; direct retrieval returned HTTP 403.

sources.title: Regulated health profession regulators
sources.scope: Current health regulator inventory; includes medical laboratory assistants and combined laboratory/x-ray technologists.

sources.title: Fair registration practices: regulatory bodies
sources.scope: Self-regulating bodies and government-regulated occupations; some regulator names have since changed.

sources.title: Regulatory bodies under fair registration
sources.scope: Official regulator list; scope is the Fair Registration Practices Act, not all occupational licensing.

sources.title: Regulated occupations
sources.scope: Official page published 8 October 2026; English occupation tables and four compulsory trades are saved.

sources.title: Work in your profession or trade
sources.scope: Contains regulated professions, compulsory trades, protected designations and mixed sectors. Explicit unregulated rows were excluded from the saved source inventory.

sources.title: Regulated health professions
sources.scope: Health profession descriptions and legislative links.

sources.title: Behaviour Analyst registration and title restrictions
sources.authority: College of Psychologists and Behaviour Analysts of Ontario (statutory regulator)
sources.scope: The title Behaviour Analyst is restricted from 1 July 2024; ABA activities themselves are not controlled acts.

sources.title: Professions and member directories
sources.scope: Forty-six linked profession groups collected in their original French labels; several groups contain more than one profession.

sources.title: Regulated trades and occupations
sources.scope: Separates professional orders, construction, compulsory qualifications, finance and teaching.

sources.title: Compulsory certificates of qualification
sources.scope: Official entry point for compulsory qualification outside the construction-sector system.

sources.title: Construction trades, occupations and job prospects
sources.authority: Commission de la construction du Quebec (statutory body)
sources.scope: Describes 25 trades, six specialized occupations and 30 occupations; scope and collective-agreement exceptions must be retained.

sources.title: Saskatchewan regulatory bodies
sources.scope: Seventy-four source occupation/regulator rows collected; title/practice scope still needs review.

sources.title: Professional licensing
sources.scope: Government licensing directory, including health and business professions; includes organizations and permit types, not only individual occupations.

sources.title: Professional licensing
sources.scope: Health and social-service licensing office; page identifies the professions it administers. Does not cover every occupation in the territory.

sources.title: Medical Profession Act
sources.scope: Confirms medical registration/licensing in Nunavut; retrieved consolidation is current to 25 January 2013, so it is not a current full inventory.

sources.title: Aircraft maintenance engineer licensing
sources.scope: Federal AME licensing concerns certification of maintenance. Do not classify every aircraft mechanic as needing an AME licence.
